meta.description: Planner builds your school's timetable from your own rules, then supports the classroom: attendance by QR code or by hand, live quizzes, games and tracked session changes.

ouverture.accroche: Your school's timetable, built from your rules. And everything that happens next in class.

emploi.texte: Rooms, teachers, groups, availability, travel between campuses: Planner places every session while respecting your hard and soft rules. Lectures, tutorials and labs follow their groups.
emploi.refus: When a session cannot be placed, Planner tells you which rule is in the way.

illustration.label: Example week built by Planner, with one unplaced session and its reason

alerte.texte: Biology lab: the teacher is not available on Tuesday morning.

appel.texte: The teacher shows a QR code. Students scan it with their phone, and their attendance is recorded. The teacher can also mark each student by hand: present, late or absent.

illustration.label: QR code attendance screen on a phone
illustration.consigne: Scan the code to mark yourself present

quiz.texte: Ten question types, images and videos, quizzes run live or as homework. Teachers can also offer games to their classes.
quiz.lien: Learn more about quizzes and games

illustration.label: Live quiz question on a phone
illustration.question: What is the derivative of x²?

report.titre: A change, tracked from start to finish.
report.texte: Every step is visible to the people it concerns. Students learn about the change before they travel.

etapes.texte: The teacher asks to move their session.
The registrar accepts the new slot.
The students concerned receive a notification.
The timetable is up to date for everyone.

donnees.texte: Access follows each person's role in the school.

points.texte: A second code protects the accounts that turn it on.
Student, teacher, registrar: each opens only what their role allows.
When the school turns AI on, it never receives student data, and teachers review what it suggests.

bientot.texte: These modules are in preparation. They are not available yet.

contact.texte: Would you like to see Planner on a fictional school, with your own rules? The contact form is coming soon to this page.

video.titre: All of Planner, in ninety seconds.

lignes: Seven apps for your school. One account.
scenes.image: The Planner logo, a graduation cap whose top is a clock; its hands turn. The seven apps appear below.

lignes: Rooms, teachers, groups, campuses: all your rules, held together.
A session can't be placed? Planner tells you which rule is in the way.
scenes.image: On a computer, the week fills up session by session. Then a notice appears: a session that could not be placed, with its reason.

scenes.titre: A class moved? Students are notified.
lignes: The teacher asks, the school office approves, the timetable updates.
scenes.image: On a phone, a session moves from Tuesday to Thursday and a notification arrives. Four steps light up: request, approval, notified, published.

lignes: By QR code: it changes every 30 seconds.
Or by hand: present, late, absent.
scenes.image: A QR code is projected in class. A phone scans it, attendance is recorded, and the number of students present goes up. Then the teacher's screen shows the class list: three buttons per student, present, late, absent; one student is marked late, another absent.

scenes.titre: Live quizzes, or at your own pace.
lignes: Ten question types, six of them live. Live, points reward accuracy and speed.
scenes.image: The ten question types line up. Then, on a phone, a live quiz question with its timer; the right answer earns points.

lignes: Ten simulations and a Linux terminal.
The terminal can also be played on the board, with the whole class.
scenes.image: Game cards line up. Then a terminal projected on the board, and a phone suggesting a command.

scenes.titre: Every class has its own space.
lignes: Materials by section, polls, school announcements.
The library opens with the same account.
scenes.image: A class space: its sections and their materials, a poll whose bars rise, an announcement. Then the library opens.

scenes.titre: The whole school at a glance.
lignes: Rooms, exams and invigilation, across several campuses.
Two-step sign-in, role-based access. When AI is turned on for your school, it never receives student data.
scenes.image: Two campuses linked by their travel time, room occupancy and an exam session. Then a six-digit verification code and the three roles.

lignes: The week, the attendance scanner, the library.
scenes.image: On a phone, the bottom bar shows the Board, Week, Scan, Library and Account tabs; the week, the scanner, then the library go by. Then the Planner logo and name.
